targets.desc-more: button[aria-label="Tap to show more book description"]

cases.sentence: type {{title}} in the Search books field
click the magnifying glass search button
open the shelf dropdown next to Want to Read
click the author name J.R.R. Tolkien
click Follow in the About the author section
click the 4.30 average rating with the ratings and reviews count
click Show more under the book description
click the Add to cart button
